qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Scale and brand in UK general insurance and retirement, but UK personal lines are structurally commoditized by price comparison aggregators where consumers switch annually for low prices. Lacks excess pricing power above claims inflation, and multi-cycle GAAP ROIC fails the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Pricing Power & Proof of Moat, REJECT). Aviva operates primarily in UK general insurance and retirement. UK personal lines (motor, home) are heavily intermediated by price-comparison aggregators, rendering the business a cyclical price-taker with zero customer switching costs. Multi-cycle economic ROIC fails the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Despite CEO Amanda Blanc's portfolio simplification divesting 8 international units and acquiring Direct Line, UK retail general insurance remains structurally commoditized by price aggregators. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC fails the 12% hurdle, and claims inflation volatility impairs underwriting returns.
